events.description: Called on each key press in the form, before the form's own handling; calling `preventDefault` skips that.
events.name: onKeyDown

events.description: Handler called when the form validation fails. By default, the first invalid field will be focused. Use `preventDefault()` to customize focus behavior.
events.name: onInvalid

events.description: Handler called when the form is reset.
events.name: onReset

events.description: Handler called when the form is submitted.
events.name: onSubmit

props.description: The fields and the submit button.
props.name: children

props.description:
True to submit on Cmd or Ctrl plus Enter, and to stop Enter alone submitting from a text box (a long form is too
easy to send by accident). Defaults to false, the browser's own behaviour.
props.name: isSubmitOnModEnter

props.description: The schema form from `useSchemaForm`, provided to the `Field.*` parts inside.
props.name: form

props.description: Where a valid submit posts its values, such as a route's `useSubmit()`; needs `form`.
props.name: submit

props.description: The URL to submit the form data to.
props.name: action

props.description: Accessibility label for the form.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: ID of element that labels the form. Creates a form landmark when provided.
props.name: aria-labelledby

props.description: Tailwind CSS classes applied to the form element.
props.name: className

props.description: The encoding type for form data submission.
props.name: encType

props.description: The HTTP method to use when submitting the form.
props.name: method

props.description: Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
props.name: render

props.description: Where to display the response after submitting the form.
props.name: target

props.description: Whether to use native HTML validation or ARIA validation. 'native' blocks form submission, 'aria' displays errors in realtime.
props.name: validationBehavior

props.description: Server-side validation errors mapped by field name. Displayed immediately and cleared when user modifies the field.
props.name: validationErrors

props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.
props.name: aria-describedby

props.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the
object.
props.name: aria-details

props.description:
Controls whether inputted text is automatically capitalized and, if so, in what manner.
See [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/autocapitalize).
props.name: autoCapitalize

props.description:
Indicates whether input elements can by default have their values automatically completed by
the browser. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/form#autocomplete).
props.name: autoComplete

props.description:
The element's unique identifier. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/id).
props.name: id

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref

props.description: An ARIA role override to apply to the form element.
props.name: role

props.description:
The inline [style](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/style) for the
element.
props.name: style
